messages:
marta.docs: opened PR to fix the API ref for /v1/classify. current examples show both `text` and `file` in the same payload and the response example lists `label: string` but runtime returns `labels: [{name, score}]`. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1307

kevin.eng: ouch, that will confuse customers. can you paste the bad vs good curl examples so i can run a quick smoke test against staging?

marta.docs: sure. bad (live site):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/classify \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model": "redwood/classify-1", "text": "hi there", "file": "uploads/123"}'
```
fixed (canonical request shape):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/classify \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model_id": "redwood/classify-1", "text": "hi there"}'
```
or file-based (only `file_id`, no `text`):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/classify \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model_id": "redwood/classify-1", "file_id": "uploads/123"}'
```

paul.sdk: our JS example used `text` and the Go snippet used `file` but neither explained exclusivity. the SDK still accepts both and chooses `file` if present, but docs should show the mutually exclusive shapes. i'll open sdk PR 612 to standardize snippets and add a compat note.

emma.prod: can we add a short migration blurb at the top: "For classify, pass either `text` (string) OR `file_id` (string). The response shape is `labels: [{name: string, score: number}]`. `model` -> `model_id` name change is also now canonical." CS will include this in the changelog.

kevin.eng: ran the text-only curl on staging  200 OK. sample response I pasted into the PR as the canonical example:
```json
{"model_id": "redwood/classify-1", "labels": [{"name": "greeting", "score": 0.987}], "request_id": "req_abc123"}
```

marta.docs: perfect, i'll replace the single-label `label: "greeting"` example with the `labels` array and update the OpenAPI schema to `labels: array<object>` with `name` and `score: number`. also changing examples to `model_id`.

ci-bot: docs/link-check: failed for docs/pull/1307  broken anchor to /sdk/go#classification-examples.

paul.sdk: i'll fix the anchor in the SDK readme and include updated Go/Python examples in SDK PR 612. will ping back when link-check is green.

marta.docs: plan: land docs PR after SDK link fix and kevin's second smoke test on file uploads. aiming to ship in tomorrow's site push. tagging all PRs in the description for coordination. thanks all.
